observations: Photo 0 shows a top-down view of a sewing machine head with a motor below it, connected by a black cord.
The machine has a metal frame, a handwheel on the left, and a presser foot with a needle assembly.
The motor below has a label with text, but it is too blurry to read clearly.
The machine appears to be in a workshop or storage area with other items in the background.
There is a watermark 'VASILIKOS FASHION OUTLET' on both photos.
The machine shows signs of use: some rust on the metal parts, especially on the motor and frame, and the cord is frayed.
